column2: I just decided to start an AI company on my own. Get me set up so you know the basics about me and the business.
We moved our headquarters to Lisbon last month, please refresh what you have on file about the company.
I have two weeks and an idea. Lay out the whole thing day by day from nothing to paying pilots.
It's day 6 of the launch plan, what am I supposed to be doing today?
It's Monday. Give me the state of the whole company on one page and tell me the three things to do this week.
Across cash, deals, product and support, what is slipping right now?
Which software should I subscribe to for each function, and which of it can plug into Claude?
I want the bookkeeping, pipeline cleanup and support triage to run on a schedule without me kicking them off.
I live in Milan but most of my investors are American. Should I incorporate in Italy or in Delaware?
What do I need to file to get the company officially registered, and how long will it take?
I need to issue my own shares with a four-year vesting schedule and keep a record of who owns what.
An advisor will get 0.5% of the company. Draft what's needed and show me the updated ownership table.
An angel sent me a term sheet with a 2x liquidation preference. Is that normal?
I want to take 300k from three angels on a convertible instrument. What paperwork do we need to close?
Write up the minutes for yesterday's directors' meeting where we approved the bank mandate.
Do my shareholders need to vote on increasing the share capital, and how do I document that?
A prospect sent over their own master services agreement. Redline it for me.
I need terms of service and an order form for my API product.
We process EU customers' support emails through a language model. What do we owe them under GDPR?
Is my hiring-screening agent considered high risk under the EU AI Act?
I want to bring on a freelance developer based in Poland. What agreement do I need so the code belongs to the company?
Should my first salesperson in Germany be an employee or go through an employer of record?
Tell me every government filing and renewal coming up in the next two months.
Do a legal health check of the company and list what's lapsed.
Can somebody else already own the brand name I picked? I'd like to register it in the US and EU.
One of our libraries is AGPL. Is that a problem for a commercial SaaS?
The company was registered yesterday. What bank, accounting package and ledger structure should I put in place?
Do I have to sign up for VAT before I send my first invoice?
Here's last month's bank export. Categorize everything and reconcile it.
Close October and give me the P&L and balance sheet.
Bill Acme 12,000 for the annual plan and make sure the tax treatment is right for a customer in France.
Three customers are more than 30 days late. Draft the reminders.
These five supplier bills arrived this week. Which should I pay first given my cash?
Prepare this month's salary run for my two employees.
Prepare the quarterly VAT return from the ledger.
Can we claim a research and development credit for the engineering work we did this year?
How many months of cash do I have left at the current burn?
What's my gross margin per customer once I account for token costs?
Help me put together the slides for seed investors and a list of funds to approach.
Write this month's update email to my investors.
I can't explain in one sentence why someone should pick us over hiring another analyst. Fix that.
Make me a battlecard against our two closest competitors.
I need a name for the company and a visual identity with colours and fonts.
Create a pitch deck template and social post formats that all look consistent.
Write and build the homepage with a demo request form.
Visitors land on the site but almost nobody signs up. Improve it.
When people ask ChatGPT for tools like mine, we never get mentioned. How do I change that?
Find the search terms my buyers use and plan articles around them.
I need 40 qualified leads next month. Design the campaigns and the nurture emails.
I have 2,000 to spend on ads. Where should it go and how do I track cost per opportunity?
Draft the announcement for our launch and a LinkedIn post in my voice.
Which journalists cover our space, and what should I pitch them?
Which conferences are worth attending this spring, and how do I get meetings out of them?
I want agencies to resell us. Outline the partner program.
Define my sales process from first call to signature, including the demo script and how to answer objections.
Buyers keep saying they don't trust an AI to do this. Give me talk tracks.
Set up the deal stages and required fields in HubSpot.
My CRM is a mess of duplicates and deals without next steps. Clean it up.
Build a list of 200 logistics companies in the Nordics with the right contacts and write the outbound emails.
Set up cold outreach so meetings get booked without me writing every email.
Someone just filled in the demo form. Reply and figure out if they're worth a call.
Here's the transcript of today's discovery call. Summarize it and write the follow-up.
The buyer wants a written offer with pricing by Friday.
Procurement sent a 120-question security questionnaire before they'll sign.
Which of my open deals are at risk, and what will actually close this quarter?
We lost four deals in a row. Find the pattern.
Before I build anything, how do I check that claims adjusters really have this problem?
I did eight customer interviews. Here are my notes, tell me what they mean.
What goes into the first version and what do I leave out?
Rank these twelve feature ideas and give me a now-next-later plan.
Write the PRD for the invoice-matching agent, with acceptance criteria.
Turn this roadmap item into user stories a coding agent can build from.
Should I charge per seat or per document processed?
Design three plans with limits and decide whether to have a free tier.
What events should I track to know if users reach value?
Pull together everything customers said this month across tickets and calls into themes.
Sketch the screens for how a user reviews and approves what the agent wants to do.
Our onboarding flow confuses people. Redesign it.
Should this be a single model call, a fixed workflow, or an agent loop, and which model do I use?
Draw up the technical design and stack for the product.
My agent picks the wrong tool half the time. Rewrite its system prompt and tool descriptions.
I need to expose our internal API to the agent as an MCP server.
Customers upload thousands of PDFs. Build the pipeline that lets the model find the right passages.
Answers cite the wrong documents. Fix retrieval quality.
Create the repository with CI and a CLAUDE.md so I can start coding.
Implement the export feature from the spec.
How do I know whether the agent is accurate enough to release?
Compare the new model against the current one on our golden set.
Write end-to-end tests for sign-up and checkout.
Run a load test before we onboard the enterprise customer.
A malicious email could tell my agent to forward the inbox somewhere. Protect against that.
Do a threat model of the app before launch.
Look over this pull request before I merge it.
Write the changelog and release notes for version 1.2 and run the ship checklist.
Get the app hosted with separate staging and production and automatic deploys.
Write the Terraform for the database and queue.
I want a dashboard and phone alerts when error rates spike.
Trace every model call with tokens and latency.
The API is returning 500s for every customer right now.
Write the postmortem for last night's outage.
Our Anthropic bill tripled this month. Find out why and bring it down.
Set budget limits per customer on inference spend.
An enterprise prospect is asking whether we are SOC 2 compliant. Get us ready.
Set up backups and a disaster recovery plan, and test a restore.
I need a support inbox with response-time targets per plan.
Which helpdesk should I use, and how should tickets be routed and escalated?
Half our tickets are the same five questions. Automate the answers with a bot that hands off when unsure.
The support bot gave a wrong refund policy yesterday. Improve it.
There are 23 unread tickets. Sort them and draft replies.
This customer is furious about a failed export. Write the response and file the bug.
Write a help article on connecting a Google Drive folder.
Document our REST API with examples.
We just signed Globex. Plan their onboarding to first value.
Which accounts are likely to churn, and whose renewal is coming up?
